```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameterized'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Expanded &ent;">
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns2" sub:attr="value">
  <!-- Top level document comment -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub:pi processing="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
    &base;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY customEntity "Entity expansion text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY externalImg SYSTEM "img.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <!-- Multi-line
       comment block with special tokens <>& -->
  <custom:section id="s1">
    <?target instruction-data?>
    <![CDATA[Nested CDATA with <tag> and &entity; syntax inside]]>
    &customEntity;
  </custom:section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <?catalog-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:head.001.001.01" xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns">
  <!-- Important catalog comment describing layout -->
  <ns:item>
    <?ns-action run?>
    <![CDATA[Raw data block 1: <root>©</root>]]>
    &ent2;
  </ns:item>
</catalog>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (testcase+)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % external_param SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %external_param;
  <!ENTITY resolved "Successfully resolved">
  <?logger debug="on"?>
]>
<testsuite xmlns="http://example.org/ts" xmlns:t="http://example.org/ts/types">
  <!-- Test suite initialization comment -->
  <t:testcase name="case1">
    <?t:directive execute="now"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <testcase-data>
        <value>Some &resolved; CDATA payload</value>
      </testcase-data>
    ]]>
  </t:testcase>
</testsuite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_pe "<!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>">
  %local_pe;
  <!ENTITY textEnt "Safe text substitution">
  <?render-engine type="vector"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Document level descriptive comment -->
  <content>
    <?xlink-link act0="load"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with unescaped markup: <foo attr="bar">&textEnt;</foo>
    ]]>
    &textEnt;
  </content>
</document>
```
